::: {.callout-note}
## Category Overview & Scope
컴퓨터비전 실무 및 연구에서 가장 광범위하게 활용되는 핵심 다운스트림 인식 태스크들을 다룹니다.

* **Object Detection:** Two-stage (Faster R-CNN), One-stage (YOLO, RetinaNet), Transformer 기반 (DETR, Deformable DETR)
* **Image Segmentation:** Semantic Segmentation (FCN, DeepLab), Instance Segmentation (Mask R-CNN), Foundation Model (Segment Anything - SAM/SAM 2)
* **Pose & Depth Estimation:** 2D/3D Human Pose Estimation, Monocular Depth Estimation (MiDaS, Depth Anything)
* **Multi-Object Tracking (MOT):** SORT, DeepSORT, ByteTrack, Transformer-based MOT
:::
